history.note: harness until the mode-cutoff restart (borg-zoo#54). The runner and observer are unchanged at the new pin; the bump keeps the harness commit at the specimens' tree after the 0100/0101/0101a fixes. A proposed runner change that would have recorded the applied configuration text (better-borg-c PR 435) was closed as mis-filed and is not needed: configuration_sha256 already identifies what a run applied.
live watchdog read could abort a run on a split UTF-8 character (better-borg-c#220); fixed by 56ccf741. The observer is unchanged between the two pins.

harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

experiment.owner_authorization: 2026-11-23: borg-reborn-rs owner ("file the zoo request for the dot arm"), filed as borg-zoo#713 (supersedes #672's dot arm, pinned to 8974509e / 345cf356); zoo owner, 2026-11-23: "ok do all of them" (the classes-18 pilot; the small tier after the gate).
experiment.prespecified: Fixed 2026-11-23, before any result of this build was read (borg-zoo#713; borg-reborn-rs #926, #1028). Two arms on track-p 8f32a8a0 (fast_fragile_count_dot ships 0, so ctl is the shipped play): ctl; dot (fast_fragile_count_dot 1). Pilot: classes-18, 100,000 turns, evidence retained, 36 cells; then small (classes-1800 starts 1-90, every class, on a seed block not yet read for a fast-fragile decision if one is available) on the owner's word. The requester's local replays: no recorded game reaches the branch that drinks the potion, dot plays the same keys as ctl on the #926 seeds 1398933929 (9653a0d480ef1dd2) and 1294425391 (2a7f2615f8c44b0b), so the pilot may well show no difference, which is a result too. Gate: no config_error; one binary; each arm's values in params-core.json; every cell ends in death, turn_cap or borg_stopped; stalls and wall timeouts apart; identical plays. Report: deaths per class and arm paired by start (rescued, newly killed, CL and DL); how often it fires, from the notes '# Fast-fragile: its own cut and poison (... world ticks of ... HP before its next action) take it below 0 from HP ...: <potion> ... (#1028)' per arm and the games they occur in. Descriptive (RULES 14).
